module accu(
    input               clk         ,   
    input               rst_n       ,
    input       [7:0]   data_in     ,
    input               valid_in     ,
 
    output  reg         valid_out     ,
    output  reg [9:0]   data_out
);

reg [1:0] counter;               // Counts number of valid inputs received (0-3)
reg [9:0] accum_register;        // Accumulated sum of inputs
reg valid_latch;                 // Flag to generate valid_out pulse

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        counter <= 2'b00;
        accum_register <= 10'b0;
        valid_out <= 1'b0;
        data_out <= 10'b0;
        valid_latch <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        valid_out <= 1'b0; // Reset valid_out each cycle
        if (valid_in) begin
            accum_register <= accum_register + data_in;
            counter <= counter + 1;
            if (counter == 2'b11) begin
                // After 4 valid inputs
                data_out <= accum_register + data_in; // Final sum for this batch
                valid_out <= 1'b1; // Assert valid_out for one cycle
                counter <= 2'b00; // Reset counter
                accum_register <= 10'b0; // Reset accumulator
            end
        end
    end
end

endmodule

module fsm(IN, MATCH, CLK, RST);
input IN, CLK, RST;
output reg MATCH;

reg [2:0] state; // State encoding

// State definitions
parameter S0 = 3'b000; // Initial state, no partial match
parameter S1 = 3'b001; // Matched '1'
parameter S2 = 3'b010; // Matched '10'
parameter S3 = 3'b011; // Matched '100'
parameter S4 = 3'b100; // Matched '1001'
parameter S5 = 3'b101; // Matched '10011' (final detection state)

always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
    if (RST) begin
        state <= S0;
        MATCH <= 0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            S0: begin
                if (IN) begin
                    state <= S1;
                end else begin
                    state <= S0;
                end
                MATCH <= 0;
            end
            S1: begin
                if (IN) begin
                    state <= S1; // stay in S1 if input is '1'
                end else begin
                    state <= S2; // move to S2 on '0'
                end
                MATCH <= 0;
            end
            S2: begin
                if (IN) begin
                    state <= S3; // move to S3 on '1'
                end else begin
                    state <= S0; // reset if '0'
                end
                MATCH <= 0;
            end
            S3: begin
                if (IN) begin
                    state <= S1; // on '1', move to S1 (partial match restart)
                end else begin
                    state <= S4; // on '0', move to S4
                end
                MATCH <= 0;
            end
            S4: begin
                if (IN) begin
                    state <= S5; // on '1', move to S5 (sequence detected)
                end else begin
                    state <= S2; // on '0', move to S2 (partial match '10')
                end
                MATCH <= 0;
            end
            S5: begin
                // Sequence detected
                MATCH <= 1;
                // After detection, prepare for next sequence detection
                if (IN) begin
                    state <= S1; // partial match restart with '1'
                end else begin
                    state <= S2; // partial match with '10'
                end
            end
            default: begin
                state <= S0;
                MATCH <= 0;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

module signal_generator(
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  output reg [4:0] wave
);

reg state; // 0: incrementing, 1: decrementing

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  if (!rst_n) begin
    wave <= 5'd0;
    state <= 1'b0;
  end else begin
    if (state == 1'b0) begin
      // Increment waveform
      if (wave == 5'd31) begin
        wave <= wave - 5'd1; // move down
        state <= 1'b1;       // switch to decrementing
      end else begin
        wave <= wave + 5'd1;
      end
    end else begin
      // Decrement waveform
      if (wave == 5'd0) begin
        wave <= wave + 5'd1; // move up
        state <= 1'b0;       // switch to incrementing
      end else begin
        wave <= wave - 5'd1;
      end
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module signal_generator(
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  output reg [4:0] wave
);

reg state; // 0: incrementing, 1: decrementing

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        wave <= 5'd0;
        state <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        if (state == 1'b0) begin
            // Increment waveform
            if (wave == 5'd31) begin
                wave <= wave - 5'd1; // decrement to avoid overflow
                state <= 1'b1;       // change direction to decrement
            end else begin
                wave <= wave + 5'd1;
            end
        end else begin
            // Decrement waveform
            if (wave == 5'd0) begin
                wave <= wave + 5'd1; // increment to avoid underflow
                state <= 1'b0;       // change direction to increment
            end else begin
                wave <= wave - 5'd1;
            end
        end
    end
end

endmodule
